## 2.2.14 - 2026-10-24

**Chore — the catalog is refreshed to `command-code@1.88.0`.** The package
drops `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5` and `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro`, which 2.2.13 shipped
core-only, so both leave the Snapshot and the last pending classification
entries go with them. Every Snapshot model is now fully enriched again.

### Model catalog

- **FACTS_PACKAGE_VERSION**: `1.87.3` → `1.88.0`; membership 94 → 92.
- `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5` and `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro` left the package's `models.md`,
  so both are pruned from the Snapshot, along with their costs and input
  modalities in the facts module. The MiMo V2.6 family is untouched.
- `moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro` is served by the listing API but not yet in
  package membership — annotate-only, it does not ship.
- The pinned slug map now reports `mimo-v2-5` and `mimo-v2-5-pro` as pending
  alongside `ling-3-0-flash-sante-free`, `pixel-canary` and
  `space-bunny-alpha` (pinned ids no longer in the Snapshot); 17 docs-ahead
  page slugs stay unpinned.

| Model                  | Change  | Before                      | After |
| ---------------------- | ------- | --------------------------- | ----- |
| `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5`     | removed | MiMo V2.5 · 1000000 ctx     | —     |
| `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro` | removed | MiMo V2.5 Pro · 1000000 ctx | —     |

### Reasoning classification

- `MODEL_REASONING_PENDING` is empty again: the two MiMo V2.5 models were its
  only entries. All 92 Snapshot models are classified in
  `MODEL_REASONING_CAPABILITY`; no classification changes.

### Deals catalog

- No changes — the MiMo V2.5 rows already left in 2.2.13, and every Snapshot
  model has a deals record (92/92 covered).
- Deals and RSC fixtures re-captured from the live docs pages.

## 2.2.13 - 2026-10-23

**Chore — the catalog is refreshed to `command-code@1.87.3`, and the Max
plan-summary test stops pinning an upstream deal.** Two retired free variants
leave the Snapshot, and `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5` / `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro` ship
core-only: the package still lists them, but the listing API and the docs RSC
no longer serve them, so per issue #132 they keep their Snapshot row while
their deals and classification rows become pending reports. The daily cron
(run 39944493194) went red on `tests/plan-summary.test.ts`, which asserted the
MiMo `98% off` row that the refresh correctly dropped — the test now derives
its rows from the catalog through the shared `discountLabel` formatter, so a
deal ending surfaces as a refresh-PR diff instead of a red suite (spec #108).

### Model catalog

- **FACTS_PACKAGE_VERSION**: `1.87.1` → `1.87.3`; membership 96 → 94.
- `minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free` and `ornith/ornith-1.5-122b:free` left the
  package's `models.md`, so both are pruned from the Snapshot, facts,
  classification and deals catalogs together. Their paid counterparts are
  untouched.
- `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5` and `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro` stay in package membership but
  are no longer served by the listing API or the docs RSC records: they ship
  core-only, absent from `MODEL_DEALS`, and parked in `MODEL_REASONING_PENDING`
  (non-reasoning at runtime until evidence arrives).
- The pinned slug map reports `ling-3-0-flash-sante-free`, `pixel-canary` and
  `space-bunny-alpha` as pending (pinned ids no longer in the Snapshot); 16
  docs-ahead page slugs stay unpinned.

| Model                             | Change  | Before                           | After |
| --------------------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------- | ----- |
| `minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free` | removed | MiniMax M3.1 Flash · 1000000 ctx | —     |
| `ornith/ornith-1.5-122b:free`     | removed | Ornith 1.5 122B · 262000 ctx     | —     |

### Reasoning classification

- The two retirements leave 92 classified entries, and `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5` and
  `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro` move out of `MODEL_REASONING_CAPABILITY` (both were
  classified non-reasoning) into `MODEL_REASONING_PENDING`, so all 94 Snapshot
  models stay covered. A pending model moves back into the capability table
  with zero code once evidence arrives.

| Model                             | Change  | Before                                        | After |
| --------------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free` | retired | efforts model (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) | —     |
| `ornith/ornith-1.5-122b:free`     | retired | reasoning-without-efforts                     | —     |

### Deals catalog

- `minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free` and `ornith/ornith-1.5-122b:free` lose their
  free rows with the retirement.
- `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5` and `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro` lose their rows (98% and 99% off
  respectively) while remaining in the Snapshot: the docs pricing table no
  longer carries them, so they ship core-only with a pending report (92/94
  snapshot models covered).
- Deals and RSC fixtures re-captured from the live docs pages.

| Model                             | Change  | Before            | After |
| --------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------- | ----- |
| `minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free` | removed | opensource (free) | —     |
| `ornith/ornith-1.5-122b:free`     | removed | opensource (free) | —     |
| `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5`                | removed | opensource        | —     |
| `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro`            | removed | opensource        | —     |

### Chores

- `tests/plan-summary.test.ts` derives each Max deal label from the live
  catalog through the shared `discountLabel` formatter with a pinned render
  date, instead of hard-coding the MiMo `98% off` literal — the assertion that
  turned the 2026-10-23 catalog-refresh cron red.

## 2.2.11 - 2026-10-20

**Fix — Go accounts on OpenCode v2 reach the legacy transport again.** models.dev
added a first-class `commandcode` catalog entry on 2026-10-16, and the v2 host's
built-in catalog plugin applies it before user plugins: the provider draft
arrives with `package: "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible"` and `settings.baseURL:
"https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1"`. `registerProvider` only claimed a
provider whose `package` was still the empty seed, so the plugin silently
stepped out of the request path — the `aisdk:` specifier was never installed and
every turn went through the host's own OpenAI-compatible client against the
Provider API, which refuses the Go plan with a raw `403 "Your Go plan doesn't
include API access. Upgrade to Provider or higher …"`. The plan-gate flip to the
legacy `/alpha/generate` transport — the only route that serves Go — could not
run either, because the plugin was no longer in the path. A catalog entry is not
an owner: the claim now gates on the `aisdk:` prefix, takes over the catalog's
`baseURL`, and strips the model-level Anthropic packages it adds
([#304](https://github.com/rashidrazak/opencode-cmd-provider/issues/304),
[#305](https://github.com/rashidrazak/opencode-cmd-provider/pull/305)). The
release also lands the catalog refreshed on 2026-10-20: membership is unchanged
at 92 models on `command-code@1.84.0`, and the deals catalog drops
`stealth/cat-jam:free`'s row and cuts `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash`'s allowance.

### Fixes

- **The provider is claimed when models.dev pre-seeds it, so Go accounts reach
  the legacy transport again**
  ([#304](https://github.com/rashidrazak/opencode-cmd-provider/issues/304),
  [#305](https://github.com/rashidrazak/opencode-cmd-provider/pull/305)): the
  empty-seed check (`provider.package === ""`) cannot tell a first-run draft
  from a catalog entry that already carries a package, and the catalog's
  `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` is not a claim on the SDK — only an `aisdk:`
  specifier is. `registerProvider` now claims any provider that is not already
  `aisdk:`, rewrites `settings.baseURL` from the catalog's Provider API root
  (`…/provider/v1`, which the transport would otherwise append to again) back to
  the bare host, and clears the catalog's model-level `@ai-sdk/anthropic`
  package so Claude models route through the plugin too. A user-declared
  `aisdk:` package still wins, and `tests/plugin-v2.test.ts` pins the
  catalog-seeded draft, the baseURL takeover, and the package stripping.

### Model catalog

- Membership unchanged at 92 models on `command-code@1.84.0`; no cost, effort or
  modality changes. Only the `FACTS_LAST_REFRESHED` stamp moved to 2026-10-20.
- `minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash` and `minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free` appear on
  the docs pages and the listing API but not in the package's `models.md`, so
  both stay docs-ahead and unpinned; the models-page slug map reports 16 pending
  rows (up from 14). `reflection/beam:free` remains a listing-API-only
  divergence note.

### Reasoning classification

- 92 entries, unchanged; the `CLASSIFICATION_LAST_REFRESHED` stamp moved to
  2026-10-20.

### Deals catalog

- `stealth/cat-jam:free` left the pricing table while remaining in package
  membership: its deal row is dropped and the model now ships core-only with a
  pending report (91/92 snapshot models covered).
- `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` allowance cut from goat 100 / pro 100 to goat 80 / pro 90;
  tier, benchmark and rates unchanged.
- `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` and `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-fast` carry an
  announced goat 100 / pro 110 budget window from 2026-10-20T01:00Z to
  2026-10-21T01:00Z; the row-level allowance is unchanged, so the catalog does
  not move.
- Deals and RSC fixtures re-captured from the live docs pages.

| Model                  | Change    | Before              | After                        |
| ---------------------- | --------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------- |
